name: @deliciousmonster/datadog-agent-binary
description: Harper component that runs the Datadog trace-agent and core-agent alongside a node, with pre-built binaries installed per platform

scripts.// typecheck: checkJs over everything, which is the point of dropping tsc as a build step: runtime/ is what a customer runs and under the old tsconfig it was the one half nothing checked. A missing node:fs import shipped through that gap.
scripts.// stage: the kit reads binary-kit.config.js; the release calls it through its own reusable workflow and these are for a developer who wants to see what a release would publish
scripts.// test: --test-timeout, because node --test defaults to 0 and a supervision change that hangs then reads as a stuck machine rather than a failure; the slowest test in this tier is 1.4s, so 120s only ever fires on a hang
scripts.// test:windows: the Windows leg's stand-in for `test`: same two directories, minus the suites test/windows-gate.mjs lists as unrunnable there, and it fails rather than exits 0 on a run that executed nothing
scripts.// test:binaries: requires real binaries already built at build/<platform>/bin, from a prior `npm run build-agent` or a CI step that already built them
